official_sources: Managing and working with asbestos L143

official_measurement_examples.name: Refurbishment or demolition survey
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states that refurbishment or demolition surveys must locate and identify asbestos-containing materials before structural work begins.

official_measurement_examples.name: Removal before major work
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states asbestos-containing materials must be removed as far as reasonably practicable before major refurbishment or demolition.

official_measurement_examples.name: Competent surveyor
official_measurement_examples.fact: A refurbishment or demolition survey must be carried out by a competent surveyor and may require destructive inspection.

official_measurement_examples.name: Licensed higher-risk work
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states most higher-risk asbestos work must be carried out by a licensed contractor.

official_measurement_examples.name: Non-licensed duties remain
official_measurement_examples.fact: Non-licensed asbestos work still has to comply with the general Control of Asbestos Regulations duties.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-2000 buildings
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE advises that asbestos can be present in buildings built before 2000 and must be considered before intrusive work.

official_measurement_examples.name: Demolition pre-construction information
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE demolition guidance identifies asbestos information as a pre-construction hazard input that should be established before work starts.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Asbestos survey, licensing and removal duties do not themselves grant planning permission or determine redevelopment capacity.

core_rules: asbestos survey completion is not planning permission
planning permission is not asbestos clearance
pre-2000 building age is a screening cue not proof asbestos is present
refurbishment survey is distinct from demolition consent
licensed asbestos contractor status is not project approval
non-licensed work is not unregulated work
notifiable non-licensed work is distinct from licensed work
asbestos register is not a land-title record
ACM removal is not proof the whole site is contamination-free
demolition method statement is not redevelopment permission
historic asbestos survey must retain its date and scope
survey access limitation must remain an evidence limitation
asbestos waste controls are distinct from planning waste policy
asbestos compliance does not create ownership or access rights
no parcel asbestos clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
